data.name: AdminSettings.AccuracyHelp
data.value: Reject location pings with GPS accuracy worse than this value. Lower values = stricter filtering (more rejections, better data quality). Higher values = accept poor GPS readings (fewer rejections, lower data quality).

data.name: AdminSettings.BatteryBest
data.value: {0} min: Best battery life – about {1} min asleep and 1 min active per cycle

data.name: AdminSettings.BatteryGood
data.value: {0} min: Good – about {1} min asleep and 1 min active per cycle

data.name: AdminSettings.BatteryHigh
data.value: {0} min: High – about {1} min asleep and 1 min active per cycle

data.name: AdminSettings.BatteryHighMaximum
data.value: {0} min: High battery drain – continuous GPS, no sleep possible

data.name: AdminSettings.BatteryIntro
data.value: Lower time thresholds require more frequent GPS wake-ups, increasing battery drain. Mobile devices wake ~60s before each ping for GPS acquisition.

data.name: AdminSettings.BatteryModerate
data.value: {0} min: Moderate – about {1} min asleep and 1 min active per cycle (recommended)

data.name: AdminSettings.DistanceHelp
data.value: Minimum distance from previous location before recording a new point. Lower values = more detailed tracks but more storage. Higher values = less detail but reduced data.

data.name: AdminSettings.HistoricBudgetHelp
data.value: 30 was Wayfarer's historical default. The current recommended value is 80; retaining 30 can slow large cold-cache navigation.

data.name: AdminSettings.HotCacheIntro
data.value: Approximate RAM budget for the in-process tile metadata hot cache used only for zoom levels ≥ 9.

data.name: AdminSettings.HotCacheOnlyMetadata
data.value: Stores tile metadata only. It does not store tile image bytes.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageCacheDisable
data.value: Set to {0} to disable image proxy caching entirely.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageCacheEviction
data.value: When exceeded, least-recently-used images are purged automatically.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageCacheExpiryHelp
data.value: Cached images older than this are re-fetched from the original source.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageCacheExpiryRecommended
data.value: Images in trip descriptions rarely change, so a long expiry is recommended.

data.value: Controls the maximum disk space for cached proxy images.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageCacheTypical
data.value: Cached images are typically 20–200 KB each.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageDownloadMaximumHelp
data.value: Maximum single image file size the proxy will download from external sources.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageDownloadOptimized
data.value: Images are optimized after download, so cached versions are typically much smaller.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageRateDefault
data.value: Default: {0}. Maximum image requests per minute per IP.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageRateHelp
data.value: When enabled, anonymous image proxy requests are limited per IP.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageRateIntro
data.value: Protect upstream image origins from abuse by rate limiting anonymous proxy image requests. Authenticated users are never rate limited.

data.name: AdminSettings.ImageRateTooltip
data.value: Rate limits anonymous proxy image requests by IP address to prevent abuse and origin flooding.

data.name: AdminSettings.LocationIntro
data.value: These settings control how often mobile devices send location pings and how much data is recorded. The app ignores incoming requests that may be too frequent or do not meet the minimum distance change from the previous recorded location.

data.value: Interactive has no proactive Wayfarer contact-rate or client-series delay. Conservative applies Wayfarer safeguards. Provider Agreement uses the preserved Custom values below. Provider requirements, Retry-After, caching, attribution, and no-prefetch rules always remain active.

data.name: AdminSettings.PolicyPreservedHelp
data.value: Administrators manage these Wayfarer safeguards independently of provider allowances. Mode changes keep the same cache identity and require no purge.

data.name: AdminSettings.PolicyPresetMismatch
data.value: The selected built-in provider endpoint does not match its maintained preset.

data.value: Select OSM Standard, OpenTopoMap, or a compatible Custom provider. Existing settings and cache are preserved for recovery; no upstream contact is made.

data.value: This setting controls the maximum cache size (in MB) for map tiles at zoom levels ≥ 9.

data.name: AdminSettings.TileCacheOsmHelp
data.value: OSM tile usage policy requires tiles to be cached for at least 7 days. Values below 256 MB are rejected.

data.name: AdminSettings.TileCachePermanent
data.value: Zoom levels 0–8 are cached permanently and do not count against this size. They consume ~1.31 to 1.75 GB.

data.name: AdminSettings.TileCachePreserved
data.value: Provider-scoped cached files are preserved when providers, credentials, or traffic modes change.

data.name: AdminSettings.TileCacheTypical
data.value: Tiles are ~10–20 KB each. The default (1024 MB) holds roughly 100,000–200,000 tiles.

data.name: AdminSettings.TileEnterKey
data.value: Enter the provider API key if required.

data.value: Presets apply their template and attribution automatically; custom providers must use HTTPS and .png tiles.

data.value: Choose a preset or provide a custom tile provider template. Tiles are still served through the local cache proxy at {0}.

data.name: AdminSettings.TileRateHelp
data.value: When enabled, tile requests are limited for all users.

data.value: Protect the tile proxy from abuse by rate limiting tile requests. Anonymous users are limited by IP address; authenticated users by user ID at a higher threshold.

data.name: AdminSettings.TileRateTooltip
data.value: Protects your tile proxy from abuse. Applies separate limits to anonymous and authenticated users.

data.name: AdminSettings.TileSavedKey
data.value: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it unchanged.

data.name: AdminSettings.TimeWarning
data.value: 2-minute threshold provides highest location detail but significantly increases database storage and drains mobile device battery (continuous GPS, no sleep possible).

data.name: AdminSettings.UploadValues
data.value: Use {0} to disable these uploads, {1} for the default, or an integer from {2} MiB.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitCooldownHelp
data.value: Prevents notification spam when users revisit the same place frequently. Visits are always recorded; this only affects SSE push notifications.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitCooldownMinimum
data.value: Minimum time before sending another notification for the same place.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitCooldownSse
data.value: Visits are always recorded; this only affects SSE notifications.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitCurrentTiming
data.value: Current: {0} min × {1} hits = {2} min to confirm a visit

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitEndHelp
data.value: Close active visit after no pings for this duration

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitEquation
data.value: Time Threshold × Required Hits = Minimum Confirmation Time

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitExample
data.value: {0} min threshold × 2 hits = {1} min minimum to confirm a visit

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitHitWindowHelp
data.value: Max time between pings to count as consecutive hits

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitHitsHelp
data.value: Number of consecutive location pings within a place's radius needed to confirm a visit. More hits = higher confidence but longer detection time.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitHitsRange
data.value: Number of pings needed to confirm a visit (2-5).

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitMaxRadiusHelp
data.value: Larger = more forgiving, but increases false positives.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitMaxRadiusRange
data.value: Maximum radius ceiling for poor GPS (50-500).

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitMinRadiusHelp
data.value: Smaller = more precise, but may miss visits with GPS drift.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitMinRadiusRange
data.value: Minimum detection radius for good GPS (10-200).

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitMultiplierEffect
data.value: Lower = stricter matching, higher = more lenient.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitMultiplierHelp
data.value: Multiplies GPS accuracy for detection radius. Example: GPS 25m accuracy with 1.0x multiplier = 25m detection radius. Higher values are more lenient but may cause false positives.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitNotesHelp
data.value: Maximum HTML characters for notes snapshot (1000-200000)

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitRejectHelp
data.value: Filters out unreliable indoor/urban canyon readings.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitRejectRange
data.value: Skip pings with accuracy worse than this (0 = disabled).

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitSearchHelp
data.value: Database query radius for nearby places (50-2000)

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitStaleHelp
data.value: Cleanup incomplete visit candidates after this

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitSuggestionRadiusHelp
data.value: Max search radius for suggestions during backfill.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitSuggestionsHelp
data.value: Suggests potential visits that don't meet strict detection criteria. Users must confirm these suggestions manually before visits are created.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitSuggestionsIntro
data.value: Settings for the "Consider Also" feature in backfill analysis. These suggestions use relaxed matching criteria and require user confirmation before creating visits.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitTierHelp
data.value: Cross-tier evidence filters GPS noise while catching near-miss visits.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitTimingHelp
data.value: Lower thresholds detect visits faster but drain more battery. Higher hit counts increase accuracy but require longer dwell times.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitTimingIntro
data.value: A visit is confirmed when the required number of pings arrive within the time threshold, spanning at least the threshold duration.

data.name: AdminSettings.VisitsIntro
data.value: Automatically detect when users visit planned trip places based on location pings. Time-based settings (hit window, stale cleanup, visit end timeout) are derived from the Location Time Threshold above.
